diff_insertions.description: dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].skipped = false; inside handleSidebarDrop setEditorTripData updater (CandidatesSidebar)
New setEditorTripData block in applyBridge clearing skipped on MEAL_SLOTS target slot (NotionTravelApp)

site_1.notes: Unconditional placement before the 'already' check is intentionally correct per spec R1. The 'already' check only gates option synthesis; it must not gate the skipped flag clear. Moving this inside if (!already) would break the fix when the option already exists in options[]. Outer guard at line 2355 (MEAL_SLOTS.has(srcSlotId)) correctly scopes this to meal slots only.

site_2.context: applyBridge inside useEffect (NotionTravelApp), new independent setEditorTripData block
site_2.notes: setEditorTripData is a stable useState setter (line 2651); omitting it from the useEffect dependency array at line 2997 is correct React practice. The block is correctly scoped to MEAL_SLOTS, guards against missing dayEntry/slots, and fires unconditionally of originSlotId value — covering the null-originSlotId sidebar-drop path (the root cause of the R2 requirement). late_arrival_placeholder is not touched.

summary.verdict: CLEAN — both diff insertions are correctly implemented and introduce no cleanliness issues

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex flagged all 4 draft findings (A, B, C, D) as false positives with PROPOSED_FIX on each. Finding A: setEditorTripData is a stable useState setter, not a missing-dep violation. Finding B: same reasoning for pre-existing bridge/preserveCurrentAccommodationOption calls. Finding C: unconditional skipped=false is required by design — moving it inside if(!already) would break the fix. Finding D: duplicate of A/B.

findings.issue: Finding A — setEditorTripData called inside useEffect without being in deps array (introduced_in_diff: true, severity: major as drafted)
findings.proposed_fix: Remove Finding A; setEditorTripData is a stable useState setter; React does not require it in deps. No code change.
findings.rationale: React useState setters are guaranteed referentially stable. Omitting them from useEffect deps is standard practice and not a lint violation in modern React (react-hooks/exhaustive-deps does not flag stable setters). Codex's PROPOSED_FIX is correct.

findings.issue: Finding B — pre-existing bridge/preserveCurrentAccommodationOption setEditorTripData calls missing from deps (introduced_in_diff: false, severity: minor as drafted)
findings.proposed_fix: Remove Finding B; same reasoning as Finding A. No code change.
findings.rationale: Pre-existing and same stable-setter reasoning. Codex correctly identifies this as out of scope.

findings.issue: Finding C — skipped=false at line 2366 is unconditional (introduced_in_diff: true, severity: minor as drafted)
findings.proposed_fix: Keep line 2366 as-is; remove Finding C. The already check controls option synthesis only, not whether the deselect happened.
findings.rationale: Codex's analysis is correct: the unconditional placement is the intended design (per spec R1 and Technical Hints: 'Add the flag clear unconditionally inside the updater, before the return updated'). Moving it inside if (!already) would silently skip the skipped-flag clear when the option is already present in options[], leaving the slot permanently gated for that case. The outer MEAL_SLOTS guard correctly limits the scope.

findings.issue: Finding D — pre-existing useEffect setEditorTripData calls without deps (introduced_in_diff: false, severity: minor as drafted)
findings.proposed_fix: Remove Finding D; duplicate false positive of A/B.
findings.rationale: Codex correctly identifies this as a duplicate of the stable-setter reasoning in A/B.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: All 4 draft findings withdrawn after applying codex PROPOSED_FIX. Final report has 0 introduced-in-diff findings.
